high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either early morning or late evening, as suggested by the soft, diffused light in the sky. The sky is a gradient of colors, transitioning from a lighter hue near the horizon to a deeper blue higher up, indicating the presence of clouds. In the foreground, there is a large sculpture of a shrimp, prominently displayed on a pedestal. The sculpture is metallic and has a modern, abstract design with sharp lines and angles. It stands out against the natural backdrop of the beach and the ocean.
